blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila Rep. Joel Chua said on Sunday that the prosecution panel would no longer pursue the bribery charge against Vice President Sara Duterte, one of the articles of impeachment filed against her. In an interview with DZMM Teleradyo, Chua, one of the House prosecutors, was asked to confirm whether the bribery case would no longer be discussed during the impeachment trial. READ: Sara Duterte trial: Bribery charge may be dropped over 2027 budget talks “Yes, it’s confirmed,” he said.
